name: Puzzle & Dragons Z
formal_name:
Puzzle & Dragons Z + Puzzle &
Dragons: Super Mario Bros. Edition: Update
description:
An update for Puzzle & Dragons Z + Puzzle & Dragons: Super Mario Bros. Edition is now available from Nintendo eShop. All customers who own a copy of Puzzle & Dragons Z + Puzzle & Dragons: Super Mario Bros. Edition should download the update. This will update the software to Version 2.0 with the following amendments:

- Various bugs have been fixed in order to provide a smoother gaming experience.

• Once the update has been downloaded, it will be installed automatically.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and recommend downloading this update to ensure a smooth game experience.
